title: Launch QA Auditor input
description: Submit up to 10 public HTTP(S) pages that you own or are authorized to inspect. The Actor makes one bounded page request per URL; it does not log in, bypass access controls, or scan private networks.

urls.title: Public page URLs
urls.description: One to ten public HTTP(S) landing pages.

timeoutSeconds.title: Timeout per page
timeoutSeconds.description: Maximum wait for each page, from 5 to 30 seconds.

acceptance.title: Acceptance policy (optional)
acceptance.description: When supplied, evaluate every page against a deterministic policy and return accepted, criteria, failedCriteria, and evidence for an AI agent.

minimumScore.title: Minimum score
minimumScore.description: Lowest acceptable launch score from 0 to 100.

allowedGrades.title: Allowed grades
allowedGrades.description: Letter grades that the agent may accept.

maximumFindings.title: Maximum findings by severity
maximumFindings.description: Optional upper bounds; omitted severities are not evaluated except high, which defaults to zero.

high.title: Maximum high findings
high.description: Largest acceptable number of high-severity findings.

medium.title: Maximum medium findings
medium.description: Largest acceptable number of medium-severity findings when supplied.

low.title: Maximum low findings
low.description: Largest acceptable number of low-severity findings when supplied.

total.title: Maximum total findings
total.description: Largest acceptable total finding count when supplied.

requiredChecks.title: Checks that must pass
requiredChecks.description: Stable check IDs that must all pass for acceptance.
